policy: Exact commit pins. Upstream trees are never modified in place; every option the HCS build forces is listed below. A pin only changes in a dedicated compatibility change (AGENTS.md 7.2).

dependencies.name: llama.cpp
dependencies.role: text + vision engine adapter (hcs_engine_llama): GGUF text inference, tokenizer, chat templates, GGML CPU/Vulkan backends, libmtmd image understanding (mmproj projector)

cmake_options.GGML_VULKAN: OFF for windows-msvc-release, ON for windows-msvc-release-vulkan
cmake_options.LLAMA_BUILD_MTMD: ON (builds only tools/mtmd = libmtmd, which links ggml+llama; LLAMA_BUILD_TOOLS stays OFF so no mtmd-cli/server)
cmake_options.MTMD_VIDEO: OFF (video needs a subprocess ffmpeg; V1 is images only)

dependencies.tested: Real GGUF text generation via HCSInfer CLI/HTTP on the target machine (CPU and Vulkan), see docs/test-evidence/M1/llama and M2/llama-adapter-README.md; real VLM image analysis (SmolVLM2-500M-Video-Instruct Q8_0 + mmproj) via HCSInfer CLI/HTTP/MCP on the target machine, see docs/test-evidence/M2-vision; real LiquidAI LFM3-Omni-2B Q8_0 + mmproj (architecture lfm3, LFM3VL projector) text, tool calling and image understanding, CPU and Vulkan, no pin change needed (docs/test-evidence/lfm3)

compile_definitions.GGML_MAX_NAME: 160 (one GGML struct layout for llama, mtmd and stable-diffusion.cpp)
compile_definitions.stbi_* -> hcs_mtmd_stbi_*: applied PRIVATE to the mtmd target only (src/engines/llama/CMakeLists.txt, 48 public stb_image symbols). mtmd compiles its own vendor/stb copy with external linkage and stable-diffusion.cpp compiles another; renaming mtmd's copy by preprocessor avoids LNK2005 in the single process without touching either upstream tree.

dependencies.name: stable-diffusion.cpp
dependencies.role: image engine adapter (hcs_engine_diffusion): text-to-image and img2img through the pinned C API

cmake_options.SD_VULKAN: OFF for windows-msvc-release, ON for windows-msvc-release-vulkan
cmake_options.SD_GGML_SOURCE_DIR: external/llama.cpp/ggml (one GGML in the process, AGENTS.md 3.3)

dependencies.known_incompatibilities: SD_USE_UPSTREAM_GGML=ON omits the patched-GGML INT8/FP8 code paths (FP8 weights are converted to F16 at load); SD1.5 Q8_0 output was byte-identical to the patched-GGML build in M1. FLUX.3 Image Klein: the pinned commit already contains VERSION_FLUX3 (src/model/integrations/flux3.cpp), so no pin bump was needed; the unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL GGUF is recognised as "Flux.3 Image Klein" under upstream GGML (docs/test-evidence/flux3/probe-no-encoder.log). A real FLUX.3 render is BLOCKED until the gated black-forest-labs text encoder/VAE are accessible (docs/test-evidence/flux3/README.md).
dependencies.tested: Real SD1.5 Q8_0 diffusion on the target machine (CPU and Vulkan, upstream CLI), see docs/test-evidence/M1/sd

dependencies.name: stable-diffusion.cpp bundled patched GGML
dependencies.role: NOT linked in HCSInfer builds (SD_USE_UPSTREAM_GGML=ON). Recorded for provenance and for M7/M8 comparisons.

dependencies.name: stb_image / stb_image_write
dependencies.role: PNG encode of generated images, PNG/JPEG decode of edit inputs (src/engines/diffusion only)

dependencies.name: libwebp
dependencies.role: WebP image I/O. Linked only by stable-diffusion.cpp's own CLI/server examples (examples/*/CMakeLists.txt), which HCSInfer never builds; src/engines/diffusion/CMakeLists.txt pins SD_WEBP=OFF. NOT in the HCSInfer binary; the licence text is still shipped for provenance. scripts/sbom.ps1 re-derives 'linked' from the SD_WEBP value in the build's CMakeCache.txt.

dependencies.name: libwebm
dependencies.role: WebM video muxing, used only by stable-diffusion.cpp's example programs; SD_WEBM is pinned OFF. NOT in the HCSInfer binary.

dependencies.name: oniguruma
dependencies.role: transitive dependency of the stable-diffusion.cpp static library (tokenizer regex)

dependencies.name: utf8proc
dependencies.role: transitive dependency of the stable-diffusion.cpp static library

dependencies.name: cpp-httplib
dependencies.local_patch: cmake/HcsHttplib.cmake writes a copy of httplib.h to the build tree with ONE access specifier changed (Server::process_and_close_socket private -> protected) so HttpServer can enforce a per-request receive deadline (soak defect D-S4, slowloris); configure fails if the declaration is not found on a version bump

dependencies.name: LZ4
dependencies.licence: BSD-2-Clause (library); CLI programs are GPL-2.0+ and are not built

dependencies.name: prime-agent
dependencies.role: coding agent candidate (ADR-011): separate Rust workspace built from source as a sidecar process (prime-agent.exe + pa-daemon.exe, Python kernel via uv); NOT linked into HCSInfer.exe and not part of the single-EXE target
dependencies.build: cargo build --release (Rust 1.96.0, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc) outside CMake; no installer scripts
dependencies.tested: builds on Windows 11 (10 m 22 s), prime-agent --version = 0.10.4; no run against HCSInfer yet, see docs/test-evidence/agent/README.md
